MIND. [1] [Cop.]
Delirium. θ Urticaria.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Cop.]
Delirium, intense headache, drowsiness, embarrassed speech. θ Urticaria.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Cop.]
Violent headache. θ Urticaria.
Headache and general malaise, with chills. θ Nettlerash.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Cop.]
Severe spontaneous epistaxis of small boys, lasting several days.
Epistaxis ; hemorrhages after wounds.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Cop.]
Flushed face, interspersed with rose-colored spots. θ Urticaria.
Red face and urticaria over whole body ; face, eyelids, lips, ears and hands swollen.
Acne which had for a long time disfigured face. θ Urinary troubles.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Cop.]
Speech embarrassed, cannot talk well. θ Urticaria.
Tongue coated white. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Cop.]
Chronic inflammation of throat.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cop.]
Loss of appetite. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh. θ Urticaria.
Great thirst. θ Urticaria.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cop.]
Spitting up of ingesta, with large quantities of mucus ; sometimes vomiting of mucus. θ Gastric catarrh.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Cop.]
Distension and fulness after eating ; spitting up of ingesta, with large quantities of mucus ; stools coated with mucus ; frequent mucous diarrhœa. θ Gastric catarrh.
Gastric troubles during menstruation, or following urticaria.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Cop.]
Colic, with flatulency, indigestion and looseness.
Hypogastrium sensitive. θ Dysentery.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Cop.]
White, diarrheic stools, generally in morning, with chilliness and colic, obliging one to bend double.
Greenish passages, mixed mucous flocculi. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
White, diarrheic, mucous stools in morning, mucus is not tenacious or stringy, but comes away in masses. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Stools often coated with mucus ; frequent attacks of mucous diarrhœa. θ Gastric catarrh.
Constipation, with large red blotches over whole body, and fever.
Stitches in rectum and intolerable burning at anus.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Cop.]
Inflammation of kidneys. θ Bright's disease.
Chronic vesical catarrh ; excessive irritation of bladder.
Spasmodic pains in bladder every morning, at nearly same hour. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
Frequent calls to urinate, with violent pains in neck of bladder on attempting it, occasional retention of urine ; after catching cold.
Burning in neck of bladder and urethra.
Inflammation of urinary organs ; swelling, dilatation and tickling at orifice of urethra, with pulsative pain throughout penis. θ Gonorrhœa.
Constant ineffectual desire to urinate ; contraction of urethra ; emission of urine in drops.
Great dysuria.
Urine can only be discharged after great effort ; stream thinner than usual, causing great pain under fourchette, when reaching glans penis. θ Dysuria after gonorrhœa.
Urine emitted in drops. θ Induration of prostate.
Urine scant and full of sediment, with burning in urethra after micturition. θ Urticaria.
Urine high colored and thick, depositing abundant reddish sediment. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
Dark red, scanty urine, with brick-dust sediment. θ Urticaria.
Urine hot and scalding, red, depositing thick, mucous sediment. θ Dysentery.
Evacuations of thick, brown, tenacious mucus, tinged with blood ; tormina and tenesmus ; sensitive hypogastrium. θ Dysentery.
Large amount of viscid mucus, some blood and detached portions of mucous tissue in urine. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
Hæmaturia in women.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Cop.]
Chronic cystitis.
Biting pain, burning and itching in urethra before and after urination ; meatus swollen and inflamed, with soreness and discharge of pus. θ Gonorrhœa.
Swelling and dilatation of orifice of urethra, with pulsative pains throughout penis.
Gonorrhœa in the early stage, no strangury.
Gonorrhœa : mild cases, or in first part of second stage, when discharge is moderate ; much urinary irritation, but no particular difficulty.
Yellow, purulent, or mucous discharge from urethra.
Chronic gleet with muco-purulent discharge.
Swelling and induration of testicles.
Gonorrhœal rheumatism.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Cop.]
Burning red spots in vulva.
Itching of vulva.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Cop.]
Respiration quick and panting ; could breathe easily when bolstered up in bed, mucous rales in whole chest, most in left lung. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
   

COUGH. [27] [Cop.]
Dry, painful cough, with dryness in larynx and huskiness.
Cough during measles.
Severe, harassing cough, with profuse expectoration of thick, heavy masses of yellow or greenish and putrid tasting mucus, sometimes bloody and in such quantities as to cause choking and vomiting. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
Spitting of blood.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Cop.]
Burning in chest ; soreness and cough.
Dyspnœa, soreness and rawness in chest and occasional stitches in left side. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
Mucous rales in whole chest, most in left lung ; dulness under left clavicle and want of normal resonance on whole of left side. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
Hæmoptysis.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Cop.]
Heart's action tumultuous, pulse irritable and 100 per minute. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Cop.]
Pain and swelling of knees and malleoli.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Cop.]
Great restlessness of extremities. θ Urticaria.
   

NERVES. [36] [Cop.]
Greatly excited during night. θ Urticaria.
General malaise. θ Nettlerash.
Weariness ; debility, unable to sit up. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Cop.]
Drowsiness or sleepiness. θ Urticaria.
Restless nights. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
   

FEVER. [40] [Cop.]
Violent chills, with headache and general malaise. θ Nettlerash.
Chilliness and coldness in forenoon, with pain in dorsa of feet ; in afternoon, heat and thirst for water.
Uneasiness during two days, followed by a very hard chill, which is succeeded by heat and an eruption ; on third day, fever subsides and eruption grows paler.
Fever and burning sensation, insomnia and nocturnal agitation. θ Urticaria.
Fever with large red blotches over body, constipation.
Perspiration profuse, of a pungent smell.
Night sweats. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
Febrile disturbance during inflammatory stage of gonorrhœa.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Cop.]
Emaciation. θ Bronchial and vesical catarrh.
Gonorrhœal rheumatism.
   

SKIN. [46] [Cop.]
Violent itching. θ Urticaria.
Chilblains.
Nettlerash, isolated patches, pale red or bright red, with violent itching.
Urticaria over whole body, face red ; dry, hot and biting skin (calor mordax), especially disagreeable to touch. θ Urticaria.
Urticaria from gastric irritation with fever and intolerable itching.
Large red blotches all over body, with constipation and some fever.
Uneasiness during two days, followed by a very hard chill, which is succeeded by heat and an eruption of very circumscribed lenticular patches ; this eruption gives rise to intense itching and pricking of skin ; it is like measles, but without any catarrhal symptoms ; on third day fever subsides, and eruption grows paler ; on seventh skin has a mottled appearance ; the eruption does not wholly disappear for five days ; no desquamation.
